TRANSPARENT BY DESIGN

Measured data.
A different perspective.

The archive covers all 48 Grands Prix across 2024 and 2025. Both seasons include measured GPS and car telemetry excerpts alongside recorded session lap timing. Each available GPS replay contains an eight-minute excerpt, downsampled to approximately 1 Hz. Car positions are interpolated between GPS samples; timing tower positions come from the recorded position feed.

The circuit outline is reconstructed from one measured lap. Elevation and surrounding structures are illustrative. Missing or stale measurements are shown as unavailable. This is a historical replay, not a live feed.

Recorded session lap times are available in Telemetry. Each race uses its actual participants and driver line-up. Retired drivers remain in the timing tower; cars without a current GPS measurement are hidden. The public repository includes ingestion, data contracts, dbt models, tests and an Airflow DAG for extending the archive.
